content.short: GeckoTerminal is a real-time DEX analytics and charting platform tracking token prices, liquidity, and trading activity across Mantle and 100+ chains.
content.description: GeckoTerminal, operated by CoinGecko, is a comprehensive DEX analytics platform that provides real-time price charts, liquidity data, and trading activity for tokens across more than 100 blockchain networks and 600+ DEXes. Users can monitor newly listed tokens, track pool liquidity changes, analyze trading volumes, and set price alerts. GeckoTerminal covers all major DEXes on Mantle Network, offering traders and researchers deep visibility into the Mantle DeFi market with up-to-the-second data.
